games.name: Gift Runner
games.description: A three-lane runner. The car drives itself and viewers make the ride harder or easier with gifts.

howTo.en: Gifts make the road harder or heal the car.
howTo.ar: الهدايا تصعّب الطريق أو تعالج السيارة.
howTo.tr: Hediyeler yolu zorlaştırır ya da arabayı iyileştirir.

actions.label: Barriers
actions.effect: Drops road barriers ahead of the car

actions.label: Speed boost
actions.effect: Traffic rushes faster for a few seconds

actions.label: Slow motion
actions.effect: Everything slows down for a few seconds

actions.label: Mud splatter
actions.effect: Mud covers the screen

actions.label: Reverse controls
actions.effect: Left becomes right

actions.label: Boss attack
actions.effect: A boss flies in and shoots at the car (1–5)

actions.label: Heal
actions.effect: Gives the car health back

actions.label: Move left
actions.effect: Moves the car one lane left

actions.label: Move right
actions.effect: Moves the car one lane right

options.label: Car health
options.help: Hits the car can take before it crashes.

options.label: Autopilot when the game starts
options.help: The car dodges by itself. You can still toggle it on the game page.

options.label: Team battle bar (when teams are on)

games.name: Tug of War
games.description: Red and blue pull a rope. Each team has its own gifts. The first team to drag the rope over the line wins the round.

howTo.en: Pick a side: every gift pulls the rope for your team.
howTo.ar: اختر فريقك: كل هدية تسحب الحبل لفريقك.
howTo.tr: Tarafını seç: her hediye ipi takımın için çeker.

actions.label: Pull for Red
actions.effect: Pulls the rope toward the red side

actions.label: Pull for Blue
actions.effect: Pulls the rope toward the blue side

actions.label: Freeze Red
actions.effect: Red can't pull for a few seconds

actions.label: Freeze Blue
actions.effect: Blue can't pull for a few seconds

actions.label: Help the underdog
actions.effect: Pulls for whichever team is losing

options.label: Red team name (empty = in the stream language)
Blue team name (empty = in the stream language)
People on each side of the rope
Progress bar and numbers above the rope
Team battle bar (when teams are on)

games.name: Tower Race
games.description: Two teams stack blocks. Gifts add blocks, wind knocks the other team's blocks off. The first tower to reach the clouds wins.

howTo.en: Gifts add blocks to your team's tower. Reach the clouds first!
howTo.ar: الهدايا تضيف طوابق لبرج فريقك. اوصل للغيوم أولاً!
howTo.tr: Hediyeler takımının kulesine blok ekler. Bulutlara ilk ulaş!

actions.label: Build Red
actions.effect: Adds blocks to the red tower

actions.label: Build Blue
actions.effect: Adds blocks to the blue tower

actions.label: Wind on Red
actions.effect: Blows blocks off the red tower

say.en: blow wind at the red tower

teamSay.en: blow wind on the other tower

actions.label: Wind on Blue
actions.effect: Blows blocks off the blue tower

say.en: blow wind at the blue tower

teamSay.en: blow wind on the other tower

actions.label: Help the underdog
actions.effect: Adds blocks to the shorter tower

options.label: Red team name (empty = in the stream language)
Blue team name (empty = in the stream language)
Team battle bar (when teams are on)

games.name: Castle Defense
games.description: Monsters march on the castle in waves. Some gifts send more monsters, others fire arrows, raise shields or call the dragon.

howTo.en: Defend the castle, or send monsters to break it!
howTo.ar: دافع عن القلعة، أو أرسل الوحوش لتهدمها!
howTo.tr: Kaleyi savun ya da onu yıkmak için canavar gönder!

actions.label: Monsters
actions.effect: Sends small monsters at the castle

actions.label: Ogre
actions.effect: Sends a big, tough ogre

actions.label: Arrows
actions.effect: Fires arrows at the nearest monsters

actions.label: Dragon fire
actions.effect: Burns every monster on screen

actions.label: Shield
actions.effect: The castle takes no damage for a while

actions.label: Repair walls
actions.effect: Repairs the castle walls

options.label: Most ogres in a wave
options.help: Random big monsters (gifts still send them).

options.label: Tower shoots every
options.help: 0 = the tower never shoots by itself.

options.label: Team battle bar (when teams are on)

games.name: Boat Storm
games.description: A little boat crosses a stormy sea. Gifts bring waves, lightning and a whale, or a sail boost, repairs and calm water.

howTo.en: Help the boat sail on, or bring the storm!
howTo.ar: ساعد القارب على الإبحار، أو اجلب العاصفة!
howTo.tr: Teknenin ilerlemesine yardım et ya da fırtınayı getir!

actions.label: Big wave
actions.effect: Sends a wave that rocks the boat

actions.label: Lightning
actions.effect: Lightning strikes the boat

actions.label: Whale
actions.effect: A whale bumps the boat hard

actions.label: Sail boost
actions.effect: Strong wind: the boat sails faster

actions.label: Repair boat
actions.effect: Patches up the boat

actions.label: Calm sea
actions.effect: No waves or lightning for a while

options.label: Team battle bar (when teams are on)

games.name: Spin the Wheel
games.description: Every spin gift turns a prize wheel with the sender's name. You write the prizes in Settings.

howTo.en: Send a spin gift and see what the wheel gives!
howTo.ar: أرسل هدية الدوران وشاهد ماذا تعطيك العجلة!
howTo.tr: Çevirme hediyesi gönder ve çarkın ne verdiğini gör!

actions.label: Spin the wheel
actions.effect: Spins the wheel once per unit

options.label: Last winners in the score panel
Team battle bar (when teams are on)

games.name: Bomb Pass
games.description: Viewers join with !join or a gift. A ticking bomb sits on one player; gifts pass it on or add time. Whoever holds it at zero is out. Last one standing wins.

howTo.en: Type !join to play. Gifts pass the bomb!
howTo.tr: Oynamak için !join yaz. Hediyeler bombayı geçirir!

actions.label: Join the game
actions.effect: Adds the viewer to the next or current round

actions.label: Pass the bomb
actions.effect: Passes the bomb to another player

actions.label: Add time
actions.effect: Adds seconds to the fuse

options.label: Countdown before the bomb is lit
Any gift also joins the game
Team battle bar (when teams are on)

games.name: Claw Machine
games.description: Each gift drops the claw for the sender. Bigger gifts make a stronger claw. Prizes won go on the winners' shelf.

howTo.en: Send a gift to drop the claw and grab a prize!
howTo.ar: أرسل هدية لإنزال المخلب والفوز بجائزة!
howTo.tr: Pençeyi indirip ödül kapmak için hediye gönder!

actions.label: Drop the claw
actions.effect: Drops the claw; higher strength grabs better

options.label: Prizes can slip out of the claw
Team battle bar (when teams are on)

games.name: Fish Catch
games.description: Gifts cast a line for the sender and catch a random fish, from tiny minnows to the legendary golden koi. Bigger gifts bring better luck.

howTo.en: Type !fish for a free cast. Gifts bring better luck!
howTo.ar: اكتب !fish لرمية مجانية. الهدايا تجلب حظاً أفضل!
howTo.tr: Ücretsiz atış için !fish yaz. Hediyeler daha çok şans getirir!

actions.label: Cast a line
actions.effect: Catches a fish; more luck means rarer fish

options.label: Team battle bar (when teams are on)

games.name: Word Guess
games.description: A hidden word shows a letter at a time. The first viewer to type it in chat scores. Gifts reveal letters or double the points.

howTo.en: Guess the word in chat. First correct answer scores!
howTo.ar: خمّن الكلمة في الشات. أول إجابة صحيحة تفوز!
howTo.tr: Kelimeyi sohbette tahmin et. İlk doğru cevap kazanır!

actions.label: Reveal a letter
actions.effect: Shows another letter of the word

actions.label: Double points
actions.effect: Correct answers score double for a while

actions.label: Skip word
actions.effect: Skips to a new word

options.label: Words (one per line, optional hint after |)
Team battle bar (when teams are on)

games.name: Vote Path
games.description: An explorer walks a path full of forks. Chat votes left or right; one side hides treasure, the other a trap. Gifts add many votes.

howTo.en: Type left or right to vote. Gifts add extra votes!
howTo.ar: اكتب left أو right للتصويت. الهدايا تضيف أصواتاً!
howTo.tr: Oy vermek için sol ya da sağ yaz. Hediyeler ek oy ekler!

actions.label: Votes for left
actions.effect: Adds votes for the left path

actions.label: Votes for right
actions.effect: Adds votes for the right path

actions.label: More voting time
actions.effect: Keeps the vote open longer

options.label: Viewers can vote by typing left / right
Team battle bar (when teams are on)
